title: Daily Recordkeeping and Early Warning Triggers
content: A successful farmer logs daily feed consumption, mortality, and weekly sample weights. A daily mortality spike exceeding 1% or a weight deficit surpassing 15% is an immediate prompt to isolate affected birds and contact the regional veterinarian via AgroZen, rather than attempting unauthorized antibiotic treatment.

quiz.question: What is the mandatory action when daily flock mortality spikes above 1%?
options: Purchase random broad-spectrum antibiotics from a pharmacy
Urgent veterinary consultation and inspect microclimate/toxic risk
quiz.explanation: Critical mortality requires immediate veterinary diagnosis and professional intervention without self-medication.
